messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTO-PAGE -> HIGH: gpu-node-23 (rack-7) kernel panic detected, kubelet NotReady. Alert: node-exporter heartbeat lost. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

alex: acked and on-call. pulling node info now.

alex: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-23 -o wide` shows Status: NotReady, AGE 12d. LastTransitionTime ~ 2026-03-14T03:12:xxZ.

maria: :wave: do we have scheduled maint on rack-7? I don't see any.

alex: no scheduled maintenance. checking kubelet logs:
```
Mar 14 03:11:59 gpu-node-23 kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
Mar 14 03:12:01 gpu-node-23 kernel: RIP: 0010:nv_gpu_driver+0x12f4/0x2b00 [nvidia]
Mar 14 03:12:02 gpu-node-23 systemd: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=0x6
```

ryan: looks like an nvidia/xid-style kernel oops. could be driver or hardware. tagging infra for serial. @infra-bot can you attach serial?

infra-bot: Serial console attached: /dev/ttyS1 -> session started.

alex: attaching now. Kernel oops repeating on boot during GPU driver init. Repro on serial: stack shows nv_gpu_driver fault.

maria: what's immediate customer impact? any model jobs failing?

alex: Canary service in us-west-2 routed inference through this pool. We're seeing ~8% increase in tail latency and ~3% error rate (worker restarts). No customer-facing 5xx on public API yet thanks to fallback routing. I will drain this node to avoid new pods scheduling.

alex: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23 && kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> drain started, terminating pods.

ryan: I'm spinning up replacement node in rack-3 (hot spare pool) and rebalancing. Creating a dedicated fastfallback pool for critical model routes. ETA ~6m.

maria: good. Please note: if eviction causes pod restarts for long-running sessions, we may need sticky-failover adjustments. Noted for customer comms.

alex: drain completed; pods moved. kubelet remains NotReady (kernel panic on boot loop).

alex: trying to do a safe reboot via IPMI: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-7 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`

infra-bot: IPMI command accepted. Node is power-cycling.

alex: serial shows kernel panic again after reboot, same nv driver stack. suspect GPU card-level fault or driver regression from last host kernel/driver rollout.

ryan: rollback of driver would be heavy on prod. Can we isolate this host and RMA hardware? How many hosts affected?

alex: only gpu-node-23 so far. health checks across rack-7 show intermittent SMART errors on NVMe on host-24 and degraded temp sensors on host-21. Not widespread but rack looks noisy. Opening infra incident INC-INF-782.

maria: customer impact summary for now: "Degraded inference latencies for a subset of hosts in us-west-2. Automatic failover prevented user-visible 5xx, small increase in tail latency (approx 8%) for a subset of traffic for ~12 minutes while we drained and rebalanced." We should hold public comms; continue internal mitigation.

ryan: I'll tag vendor and start RMA for gpu-node-23. Can we mark node as quarantined so autoscaler doesn't pick it?

alex: `kubectl label node gpu-node-23 redwood/quarantined=true` -> labeled. Also adding taint `redwood/quarantine:NoSchedule` to be safe.

maria: creating a quick incident ticket with timeline and impact. I'll add logs and the drain commands. Ticket: RW-INC-2026-0314-1 (internal).

alex: rolling checks: node replacement pool is online, critical routes moved to fallback pool. Monitoring shows latency normalized to baseline ~ +1% after spillover.

ryan: good. I'll coordinate rack sweep for the other noisy hosts (host-21/24). ETA for vendor onsite RMA: 24-48h.

maria: who should own the postmortem? SRE with infra assist. I'll assign to @maria. Add runbook link: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/kernel-oops-rm.

alex: handoff: i'm done for my shift in 25m, but I'll leave notes in the ticket. If kernel oops reappears, escalate to hardware ops and open up a customer-facing status only if impact widens.

ryan: ack. tagging @oncall-rotation for overnight watch and setting a smoke-check cron to validate tail lat every 15m for next 12h.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by alex. Follow-up action created: RW-INC-2026-0314-1.

maria: thanks team. closing channel for now, will reopen if node shows recurrence. :white_check_mark:"
